analysis: The only changes in this PR to docs/provider/cli-reference.md are a date bump (line 3) and a rewrite of the Qwen27 TP assistant setup paragraph (around line 2456). The supplied units (head lines 1237-2116) are unchanged surrounding documentation, with no changed lines in them. I examined them for security-relevant claims that the change might contradict. The paragraph is documentation only, so no code, authorization or attestation behavior changes. Its content says plain `darkbloom cluster` serves through Darkbloom and plans without the assistant under the default `auto`. The assistant is described as unqualified for public traffic, and explicit `on` keeps it but the pair is then not offered to the coordinator. That is consistent with the threat model's fail-closed posture (T-052 and T-054, which cover unqualified builds and assistants not being treated as authorized). It does not weaken any boundary (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011). The surrounding text on logout, the add-on hold socket, the SSD prefix cache (T-041), report upload redaction and update hash verification matches the existing threat-model descriptions, and nothing here suggests new attack surface. Remaining uncertainty: the PR code that implements the `auto` and `on` cluster behavior (the registered-with-coordinator assistant exclusion) is not in the supplied units, so it was not verified that the code enforces what the docs state. The truncated patch excerpt could not be checked beyond line 2456.
